context: An architecture author must research a consequential software decision and explain the same recommendation in a paper and slide deck. The reader has not seen the conversations or working notes. The host agent supplies retrieval and authoring capabilities; the kit coordinates durable artifacts.
problem: Separate, conversational drafts can lose the reasons for a choice and drift in terminology, evidence, diagrams or caveats. This is the failure mode the proposal is designed to address, not a measured prevalence claim.
stakeholders: Engineering leader deciding whether to invest
invariants: Each C4 zoom has a valid parent
The paper and deck preserve the same conditions
Changed canonical content requires a new review
An unavailable required output cannot be called complete

constraints.statement: Prefer standard files and Python 3.10+ over a managed orchestration dependency
This release has not been benchmarked for publication quality

terms.agent: A model-driven worker using the tools supplied by its host
terms.gate: A test whose failure prevents a stage transition
terms.C4 model: Four levels of software structure: context, containers, components and code

questions: Which records must survive a host switch?
When is a simple checklist sufficient?
